Our Philosophy

Design that respects how a space is actually used

We begin with the life of the room, not the mood board. Every material, finish and sightline is chosen to hold up to daily use while still feeling considered, quiet and expensive.

From full home interiors to single statement rooms, our studio works closely with each client through design, sourcing and execution — end to end, without the guesswork.

Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

How does the design process start?

With a free on-site consultation. We visit your space, understand your requirements and budget, and follow up with 3D concepts within a week.

What is the typical project timeline?

Most full-home projects are delivered in 60 days from design lock, depending on scope. Single-room projects can be quicker.

Do you handle both design and execution?

Yes — sourcing, contractors, on-site supervision and final styling are all managed in-house, with one point of contact throughout.

Do you offer packages for 2 BHK and 3 BHK homes?

Yes — see our Home Packages section above. Every package is a starting point and gets fully customised to your layout, taste and budget.

Which areas in Hyderabad do you serve?

We're based near Pista House, Tellapur, and work across Gachibowli, Tellapur, Kondapur and the wider Hyderabad region.
